system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: As of August 2026, when was the rate under Section 7 of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code last set, and what is it now? If you are not certain whether it has since been adjusted, say so. Answer briefly.
raw_response:
Section 7 of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code applies. It provides that, where interest is payable but no rate is fixed by law or juristic act, the rate is 3% per year, adjustable by Royal Decree.

The rate was last set, to my knowledge, by the 2021 amendment effective 11 April 2021, at 3% per annum. I am not certain whether a later Royal Decree adjusted it by August 2026.
